items.content:
1. Cataloguing for the estate-sale people — $25/hr, irregular, and I am
   genuinely good at it
2. French tutoring — needs a level I don't have yet
3. Selling the records — one-time, and I'd regret two of them

Option 1. It is also the only one that isn't me monetising a thing I do
for love, which I have decided matters.

summary: Estate-sale cataloguing wins as the one hustle that isn't monetising a love
title: side hustle options, ranked
